verdict.rationale: Asking whether a desktop OS exposes its UI functions programmatically (CLI or system APIs) is a fair question, so the axis applies. The evidence only mentions isolated command-line conveniences, such as installing packages 'with just a single command'. Nothing documents an API that matches what the UI can do, so this is adjacent at best and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
